# Role playbooks

| Family | Role | Risk |
|---|---|---|
| engineering | [Frontend Developer](frontend-developer.md) | UI that works on the author's machine but breaks on real devices, browsers, or for keyboard and screen-reader users. |
| engineering | [Backend Developer](backend-developer.md) | Breaking API contracts or corrupting data during migrations. |
| engineering | [Full-stack Developer](fullstack-developer.md) | Many layers and fast-moving libraries: a change passes tests in one layer and breaks another. |
| engineering | [Mobile Developer](mobile-developer.md) | Behavior that differs across OS versions, devices and offline conditions. |
| engineering | [Embedded Engineer](embedded-engineer.md) | Timing, memory and hardware assumptions that fail on the real board. |
| engineering | [Game Developer](game-developer.md) | Frame-time regressions and gameplay bugs that only show up in play. |
| quality-ops | [QA / Test Engineer](qa-engineer.md) | Tests that pass while the product is broken. |
| quality-ops | [DevOps Engineer](devops-engineer.md) | A pipeline or infrastructure change that breaks every team's deploys. |
| quality-ops | [Site Reliability Engineer](site-reliability-engineer.md) | Unreliable service, or noisy alerts that hide the real incident. |
| quality-ops | [Cloud Engineer](cloud-engineer.md) | Cost overruns and misconfigured access. |
| quality-ops | [Security Engineer](security-engineer.md) | Vulnerabilities shipped because review focused on function rather than abuse. |
| quality-ops | [Database Administrator](database-administrator.md) | Locking, data loss or slow queries caused by schema changes. |
| quality-ops | [System Administrator](system-administrator.md) | Undocumented manual changes that cannot be reproduced or audited. |
| data-ai | [Data Engineer](data-engineer.md) | Silently wrong numbers: pipelines succeed while the data is wrong. |
| data-ai | [Analytics Engineer](analytics-engineer.md) | Metric definitions that drift between models and dashboards. |
| data-ai | [Data Analyst](data-analyst.md) | Decisions ride on the numbers: a wrong denominator becomes a wrong decision. |
| data-ai | [Data Scientist](data-scientist.md) | Answering the wrong question, or leakage that makes a model look better than it is. |
| data-ai | [ML Engineer / MLOps](ml-engineer.md) | Models that degrade silently after deployment through drift or training/serving skew. |
| data-ai | [AI Engineer](ai-engineer.md) | Non-deterministic output that passed once, and prompt injection through tools and content. |
| data-ai | [Data / AI Platform Engineer](data-ai-platform-engineer.md) | One change reaches every team that uses the platform. |
| architecture-leadership | [Software Architect](software-architect.md) | Expensive-to-reverse decisions made implicitly. |
| architecture-leadership | [Tech Lead](tech-lead.md) | Velocity lost to unclear standards and unreviewed risk. |
| architecture-leadership | [Engineering Manager](engineering-manager.md) | Commitments made without capacity, or without visibility of risk. |
| product-delivery | [Product Manager](product-manager.md) | Building the wrong thing well. |
| product-delivery | [Business Analyst](business-analyst.md) | Ambiguous requirements that each team reads differently. |
| product-delivery | [UX Designer](ux-designer.md) | Interfaces that look finished but fail real users. |
| product-delivery | [Technical Writer](technical-writer.md) | Documentation that is wrong, stale or written for the author instead of the reader. |
| product-delivery | [Scrum Master / Agile Coach](scrum-master.md) | Ceremonies without outcomes: work that looks planned but does not flow. |
